corporate_events.detail:
Waktu: 10:30:00 · Lokasi: Ballroom 3, THE Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Pacific Place, Jalan Jendral Sudirman KAV 52-53, Sudirman Central Business District, Jakarta, Indonesia, 12190 Kota Adm. Jakartaselatan · Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 annual report and audited financial statements, granting full discharge to the Board of Directors and Commissioners for their 2025 duties.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved the 2026 honorarium for Commissioners and delegated authority to the Nomination and Remuneration Committee to set specific salaries and bonuses for both boards.
Agenda #3: Shareholders approved appointing Purwanto, Susanti dan Surja (Ernst & Young Global Limited) to audit the company's 2026 consolidated financial statements.
Agenda #4: The company presented a report regarding the realization of the use of proceeds to shareholders, which required no formal resolution.
Agenda #5: The company reported the conclusion of its share buyback period which ran from June 19, 2025, to June 18, 2026.
Agenda #6: Shareholders approved renewing the authority to issue up to 1.5% of paid-up capital annually for 10 years for employee and management share programs.
Agenda #7: The meeting approved amending the Articles of Association to increase issued and paid-up capital for the Share Ownership Program and authorized the Board of Commissioners to execute the issuance.
Agenda #8: Shareholders approved a share buyback plan for 2026-2027 with a maximum budget allocation of Rp3,500,000,000,000.
Agenda #9: The meeting approved adjusting the company's purpose and objectives in Article 3 of the Articles of Association to align with the 2025 Indonesia Standard Industrial Classification.
Agenda #10: Marjorie Tiu Lao was reappointed as Independent Commissioner with a term effective until the 2029 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders.
Agenda #11: Agus D.W. Martowardojo was reappointed as President Commissioner with a term effective until the 2029 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders.
Agenda #12: Santoso Kartono was reappointed as a Commissioner with a term effective until the 2029 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders.
Agenda #13: The Board of Directors was authorized to notarize the new composition of the Board of Commissioners and Directors and notify the relevant authorities.
Agenda #14: The company utilized a multiple voting share structure with Series A and Series B shares to determine meeting quorums and voting rights.
